items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview, 1961-02-02
items.q: That was part of the original tuxedo brass band. Ones Trapania... He played the bass drum, and I played the snare drum.

ctx.x: Did they play the same kind of stuff as they played?

It's mostly the same stuff you play in the day. Lots of funeral marches. I'll tell you how the bands did them days. Any band had a funeral march. They'd take the name of it, so the other band wouldn't know the name of it. Yeah, yeah. And the first man that started me on the parade was Ones Trapania, playing the parade. He played the bass drum, and I played the snare drum. That was part of the original tuxedo brass band.
